## Checklist

- [ ] This change is scoped to its Issue and uses a non-`main` branch.
- [ ] Requirements/RFCs/ADRs are linked and updated where needed.
- [ ] Tests fail without the change and pass with it, or the limitation is explained.
- [ ] No unimplemented feature is advertised as supported.
- [ ] No credential, token, cookie, SSH key, passphrase, or private data is present.
- [ ] Documentation and release claims match current evidence.
- [ ] Commits include DCO sign-off.
